newPlatforms.canonicalName: CJSR FM 88.5 Digital and Physical Album/EP Submission Route
newPlatforms.category: non-profit campus and community radio airplay
authorizedRoutes: Send a digital album or EP to music@cjsr.com
Provide downloadable files through a stable cloud link or Bandcamp download code
Mail or drop off playable physical media to the published CJSR Music Department address

eligibility.digitalDelivery: Downloadable files; Bandcamp download codes, Dropbox, Google Drive or comparable stable cloud storage
eligibility.internationalEligibility: confirmed by explicit outside-Canada customs guidance
eligibility.aiPolicy: Music wholly generated by AI is not eligible for airplay

businessContact.name: CJSR Music Department
businessContact.verification: The mailbox is published on CJSR's official Submit Music page specifically for digital album and EP submissions. Verification covered first-party publication, valid syntax, official-domain alignment and explicit Music Department purpose. No SMTP, MX, catch-all or mailbox-level probe was performed.

formControls.adjacentPaidOfferExcluded: The optional CAD 200 local advertising package is separate from editorial music submission and was not queued.

newPlatforms.activityVerification: CJSR published a chart on July 8, 2026 covering airplay for the week ending July 7, 2026. The official site remains active and exposes current schedule, on-demand audio and electronic, hip-hop and international genre charts.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: A human must choose an eligible album or EP rather than a single, confirm that the release is not wholly AI-generated, prepare downloadable files and complete metadata, avoid streaming-only and expiring links, include track lengths, focus tracks, artist origin, a one-sheet and language warnings, and send manually. The optional local advertising package must remain separate from editorial consideration.

newPlatforms.canonicalName: Stereofox SubmitHub or Groover Music Submission Route
newPlatforms.category: independent online music publication, playlist curator and record label
authorizedRoutes: Use the SubmitHub page linked from Stereofox's official Music Submissions section
Do not send music by email or Discord

eligibility.internationalEligibility: not explicitly restricted on the reviewed first-party page
eligibility.pricing: External platform may expose free or paid credit options; no mandatory payment confirmed during passive review

businessContact.name: Stereofox editorial team
businessContact.verification: Stereofox's official page explicitly states that email and Discord submissions are not processed and directs music exclusively to its linked SubmitHub page or Groover. No email address was inferred, guessed or used.

formControls.adjacentGeneralContactFormExcluded: The first-party general contact form is for non-music enquiries and was not used as a submission substitute.

newPlatforms.activityVerification: Stereofox's official homepage displayed active playlists, current editorial posts and a 2026 copyright notice when reviewed on July 15, 2026. Current playlist categories include electronic, electronica, progressive house, melodic house, UK garage, chill electronica, instrumental hip-hop, soul and R&B.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The authorized routes are external account-based platforms. A human must sign in, inspect current fields, consent, privacy, CAPTCHA, targeting and free-versus-paid credit options, choose an appropriate MarcsMusic release and submit manually. Stop before payment unless separately approved. Do not use email, Discord or the general contact form as workarounds.

deduplication.result: Repository code searches returned no prior canonical CJSR or Stereofox submission opportunity. CJSR's digital email and physical-delivery methods were consolidated into one record; its optional local advertising offer and general contacts were excluded. Stereofox's SubmitHub and Groover methods were consolidated into one record; its email, Discord and general-contact routes were excluded.

notes: CJSR is a free-first album/EP route with a verified public Music Department mailbox, authorized physical delivery, explicit outside-Canada customs guidance and a January 2026 policy rejecting wholly AI-generated music. Stereofox authorizes only SubmitHub or Groover, which introduces account, consent and possible credit/payment boundaries; email, Discord and the general contact form are not valid substitutes. No email, form, account, file, link, physical package, CAPTCHA, payment or anti-bot control was submitted or bypassed.
